clock.note: videoTimeMs = eventUptimeMs - recordingStartUptimeMs. Anchored right after MediaRecorder.start() (called at recorderStartCalledUptimeMs); the first video frame can lag this by a few tens of ms. MediaRecorder cannot report the exact first-frame time. Bounds are screen pixels, which equal video pixels (video is recorded at native size).
